transcript: Speaker A (Voiceover): एक आईबी ऑफिसर ने सबसे खतरनाक मिशन उठाया। इंग्लिश टीचर बनके मुंबई के सबसे बड़े डॉन के घर में घुसा। और इस मिशन में उसका साथ दिया इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप के लेसन्स ने। क्योंकि उस घर में एक गलत शब्द और सीधा मौत की दस्तक। [An IB officer took on the most dangerous mission. Becoming an English teacher, he entered the house of Mumbai's biggest don. And in this mission, he was supported by the lessons of the English Seekho app. Because in that house, one wrong word means a direct knock of death.] Speaker B (Shekhar): अरे वाह! आज सूरज कहाँ से उग गया? तुम यहाँ मुझसे पहले आ गयी। [Oh wow! Where did the sun rise from today? You came here before me.] Speaker C (Girl): मेरा मन हुआ तो आ गयी। [I felt like it, so I came.] Speaker B: गुड। तो आज हम कुछ नया सीखेंगे। [Good. So today we will learn something new.] Speaker D (Earpiece Voice): शेखर, अब बोर्ड पर लिखो। [Shekhar, now write on the board.] Speaker B: ये दुनिया तीन वर्ड्स पे चलती है। पहला है... Want. Want. हमें जो चाहिए। दूसरा... Need. Need. जिसकी हमें ज़रूरत है। और तीसरा... Have. Have. वो जो हमारे पास पहले से है। एक्ज़ाम्पल के तौर पे... You have a smartphone. You need a copy. I want... [This world runs on three words. The first is... Want. Want. What we want. Second... Need. Need. What we need. And third... Have. Have. That which we already have. For example... You have a smartphone. You need a copy. I want...] Speaker C: तुम कल रात मेरे कमरे में आये थे। अपनी जान खतरे में डाल के तुम मुझे बचाने क्यों आये थे? तुम्हारी want और need क्या है? [You came to my room last night. Putting your life in danger, why did you come to save me? What is your want and need?] Speaker A: क्या है शेखर की वांट और नीड? जवाब जानने के लिए खोलो इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप और सर्च करो जासूस टीचर। ये बस ड्रामा नहीं, सीखने का मौका है। जो इंग्लिश इस मिशन की जान थी, वो आप भी सीखो उसी ऐप पर। तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [What is Shekhar's want and need? To know the answer, open the English Seekho app and search 'Jasoos Teacher'. This is not just drama, it's an opportunity to learn. The English that was the life of this mission, you learn it too on the same app. So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: JASOOS TEACHER, English Seekho, Well done Shekhar, perfect Tony, keep the gun on his head, I will kill him, But first I have to make a deal, Aaj suraj kahan se ug gaya?, Tum yahan mujhse pehle aa gayi, Mera man hua toh aa gayi, Toh aaj hum kuchh naya sikhenge, Shekhar ab board par likho, ENGLISH CLASS, WANT, NEED, HAVE, Jiski hamein zaroorat hai, Aur teesra, Example ke taur pe..., You have a smartphone, You need a copy, I want..., Tum kal raat mere kamre mein aaye the, Apni jaan khatre mein daal ke tum mujhe bachane kyun aaye the?, Tumhari want aur need kya hai?, jasoos teacher, INSTALL NOW
summary: The ad features a dramatic skit called 'Jasoos Teacher' about an undercover agent posing as an English tutor. It uses a suspenseful cliffhanger during a grammar lesson to pique curiosity. Viewers are prompted to download the English Seekho app to watch the full series and learn English.
